title: Plural affirmative agreement
focus: Choose the correct affirmative olla form from the complete paradigm.

exercises.prompt: Build the form from the subject. Complete “You are at home in the evening.” Te ____ kotona illalla. Address one person politely with te; use the same plural agreement.
exercises.explanation: Te takes olette, the matching present-tense form of olla.

optionFeedback.olemme: “olemme” does not fit this subject or construction. Te takes olette, the matching present-tense form of olla.
optionFeedback.olette: Correct. Te takes olette, the matching present-tense form of olla.
optionFeedback.ovat: “ovat” does not fit this subject or construction. Te takes olette, the matching present-tense form of olla.
